body.p: Applicant has amended claim 1 as indicated in the above claims. Support for the
amendments is found in original claims 1 and 11, and paragraphs 3, 15, 16, 41, 43 and 55 of the original description.
Claims 12 and 16 have been amended in a corresponding manner.
Claims 2, 4-10 and 13-15 have been amended in response to the formalities listed in section 2 of the Office action.
Claim 3 has been amended to correct a typographical error.
Claim 11 has been cancelled without prejudice or disclaimer.
The Examiner's rejections are respectfully traversed.
Claims 1-2 and 4-16 were objected to due to certain informalities. The above amendments address these objections.
Applicant's Reply to the Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. Q 112

Claims 1-11 and 16 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112. Claim 1 has been amended to recite that the display is a touchscreen and that the accessory interface unit has one or more communication ports. In view of these amendments, these rejections are moot.
Applicant's Reply to the Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. Q 102 and Q 103
Claims 1-2 and 5-17 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by U.S. Publication No. 2020/0369148 to Bongard et al. ("Bongard").
Claim 3 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Bongard in view of U.S. Publication No. 2020/0231168 to Uthaicharoenpong et al. ("Uthaicharoenpong").
Claim 4 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Bongard in view of Uthaicharoenpong, and in further view of U.S. Publication No. 2020/0216087 to Kim et al. ("Kim").
These rejections are respectfully traversed.

Bongard discloses a system and method for controlling vehicle accessories through a configurable user interface (UI) module connected to a processor and memory. The UI module receives inputs and generates outputs based on stored UI rules and a shared parameter list. These rules govern the generation of outputs when specific states appear in the parameter list. Both the UI module and a controller module respond to these states. The UI allows user input through a graphical interface displayed on a touchscreen and can process input from users, the vehicle, or sensors. The system enables users to control or adjust accessories, such as starting or stopping an accessory, or modifying its operational settings.
However, Bongard fails to disclose at least:
"generating, for display on a touchscreen, an initial state of an accessory-equipped
vehicle, wherein the initial state includes default values of environmental variables and default values of operational parameters of vehicle and accessory components and sub-systems
[emphasis added];
generating a graphical user interface, on the touchscreen, allowing a user to specify a test configuration [emphasis added] comprising:
a user-specified high-level accessory-related rule relating to the operation of
the accessory-equipped vehicle;
a simulated event [emphasis added]; and

p.u: an environmental variable describing an environment in which the accessory-
uipped vehicle is operating, and an operational parameter setting a state of the

body.p: vehicle and accessory components and sub-systems [emphasis added];
simulating a resultant state of the accessory-equipped vehicle when operating under the control of the test configuration [emphasis added];
displaying, on the touchscreen, the resultant state of the accessory-equipped vehicle before loading the test configuration into the accessory-equipped vehicle [emphasis added];"
Uthaicharoenpong and Kim, either alone or in combination, fail to fill the gaps of Bongard.

For at least these reasons, Applicant respectfully submits that each of the amended independent claims is patentable. Applicant further respectfully submits that the dependent claims, as amended, are patentable by virtue of their respective direct and ultimate dependencies from allowable independent claims, as well as by virtue of the patentably distinct subject matter that they recite.

For at least the foregoing reasons, Applicant respectfully submits that this application, as amended, is in condition for allowance. Reconsideration and prompt allowance of this application are respectfully requested.
Respectfully submitted,
/Olivia Brock/
